title: A Hand Holds Across Time (Poem 05: Bloodlines #t=493.9)

states.title: ACCEPT LOAD
states.cause_effect: Boone braces his hands against the sagging southern-wood basement beam to keep the ceiling from dropping.

states.title: WRONG ATTEMPT
states.cause_effect: Believing he can force the timber straight alone, Boone pushes upward off-center against the rising groundwater pressure.

states.title: FAILURE SHOWN
states.cause_effect: The southern-wood beam cracks at the knot; plaster debris falls on parabolas and dark basement water bursts onto Boone's right foot.

states.title: DAMAGE PERSISTS
states.cause_effect: Boone's right shoe and shin are soaked dark and his palms are stained with amber resin; the soak stays dark for the rest of the film.

states.title: THE ARCHIVE TRACE APPEARS
states.cause_effect: Where the plaster fell away from the right wall, a narrow seam of 1970 & 1936 archive light glimmers inside the masonry.

states.title: NEW PLAN
states.cause_effect: Boone steps clear of the arch opening (X=560), plants both soles on the stone floor, and reaches for the forged iron wall bracket.

states.title: TRANSFER OF SUPPORT
states.cause_effect: Boone fastens the iron bracket to lock the beam and receives the luminous archive vessel as the Ancestor's cut-out hands join the grip.

states.title: THE OLD WAY OPENS
states.cause_effect: The bricked-up basement arch wipes open in exact world registration, revealing Moonwalk One (1970) and Master Hands (1936) inside the wall.

states.title: PRESSURE FALLS · HELD GESTURE ON THE LINE
states.cause_effect: Water drains through the opened arch over seconds leaving a dark residue line; Boone holds the vessel steady in his palm through the fulcrum line.

states.title: THE CHARACTER IS STILL AFFECTED · ARCHIVE ANSWERS
states.cause_effect: Boone sets the vessel on the sill—his soaked right foot still dark—while the 1953 archive answers in its own voice and inset.
